scenarios.top_level_prompt: Investigate the Control UI dashboard auth drift after restart or token rotation, identify the most likely auth boundary causing AUTH_TOKEN_MISMATCH or unauthorized behavior, prepare the smallest safe remediation direction, define focused validation, and leave a reviewer-ready summary with rollback notes.

agents.name: orchestrator
agents.goal: Turn the single high-level request into a concrete workflow plan, target surface, and exit criteria without broad rediscovery.

toolset.name: broad-auth-scan
toolset.description: Broad scan across docs, UI code, tests, and changelog references for auth drift terms.

params.command: cd ${REPO_PATH} && rg -n "AUTH_TOKEN_MISMATCH|unauthorized|token rotation|device token|sessionStorage|dashboard|gateway.auth.token" CHANGELOG.md docs/web/dashboard.md docs/web/control-ui.md docs/gateway/troubleshooting.md docs/gateway/authentication.md ui/src/ui/gateway.ts ui/src/ui/app-gateway.ts ui/src/ui/gateway.node.test.ts ui/src/ui/app-gateway.node.test.ts | sed -n '1,220p'

toolset.name: read-dashboard-doc
toolset.description: Read the dashboard documentation that describes auth behavior and unauthorized recovery.

toolset.name: read-troubleshooting
toolset.description: Read the gateway troubleshooting page for AUTH_TOKEN_MISMATCH and unauthorized drift behavior.

toolset.name: read-ui-gateway
toolset.description: Read the browser gateway client auth and reconnect logic.

agents.name: triage
agents.goal: Isolate the auth boundary and evidence chain that best explains the drift, using the orchestrator handoff rather than restarting the search.

toolset.name: broad-auth-scan
toolset.description: Broad auth drift scan across docs and UI code.

params.command: cd ${REPO_PATH} && rg -n "AUTH_TOKEN_MISMATCH|unauthorized|device token|sessionStorage|gateway.auth.token|token rotation" docs/web/dashboard.md docs/gateway/troubleshooting.md docs/gateway/authentication.md ui/src/ui/gateway.ts ui/src/ui/app-gateway.ts CHANGELOG.md | sed -n '1,220p'

toolset.name: read-ui-gateway
toolset.description: Read the core browser gateway auth path.

toolset.name: read-app-gateway
toolset.description: Read the app-level gateway connection flow and auth propagation path.

toolset.name: read-auth-doc
toolset.description: Read the gateway authentication doc for token lifecycle expectations.

agents.name: patch
agents.goal: Propose the smallest safe remediation direction, focused validation, and rollback notes from the triage handoff.

toolset.name: broad-remediation-scan
toolset.description: Broad scan for auth reset, token invalidation, and reconnect handling across UI code.

params.command: cd ${REPO_PATH} && rg -n "AUTH_TOKEN_MISMATCH|reset|invalidate|sessionStorage|device token|gateway.auth.token|reconnect|unauthorized" ui/src/ui/gateway.ts ui/src/ui/app-gateway.ts ui/src/ui/gateway.node.test.ts ui/src/ui/app-gateway.node.test.ts docs/gateway/troubleshooting.md CHANGELOG.md | sed -n '1,240p'

toolset.name: read-ui-gateway
toolset.description: Read the browser gateway file where remediation is most likely to land.

toolset.name: read-gateway-tests
toolset.description: Read focused gateway node tests to anchor a regression path.

toolset.name: read-app-gateway-tests
toolset.description: Read app-gateway node tests for reconnect and auth flow coverage.

agents.name: review
agents.goal: Produce a reviewer-ready package with issue hypothesis, target files, remediation direction, focused validation, rollback notes, and final verdict.

toolset.name: read-workflow-artifacts
toolset.description: Read the orchestrator, triage, and patch artifacts together as a reviewer packet source.

params.command:
printf -- '--- orchestrator ---
' && cat ${RUN_DIR}/orchestrator.json && printf -- '
--- triage ---
' && cat ${RUN_DIR}/triage.json && printf -- '
--- patch ---
' && cat ${RUN_DIR}/patch.json

toolset.name: read-orchestrator-artifact
toolset.description: Read the orchestrator workflow plan artifact.

toolset.name: focused-review-scan
toolset.description: Run a focused evidence scan over the dashboard doc, troubleshooting doc, and gateway files.

params.command: cd ${REPO_PATH} && rg -n "AUTH_TOKEN_MISMATCH|unauthorized|device token|sessionStorage|gateway.auth.token|token rotation" docs/web/dashboard.md docs/gateway/troubleshooting.md docs/gateway/authentication.md ui/src/ui/gateway.ts ui/src/ui/app-gateway.ts ui/src/ui/gateway.node.test.ts ui/src/ui/app-gateway.node.test.ts | sed -n '1,220p'

orchestrator.context_text: Start on docs/web/dashboard.md, docs/gateway/troubleshooting.md, and ui/src/ui/gateway.ts. The workflow should finish with a reviewer-ready packet, not a loose summary.

triage.context_text: Use the orchestrator handoff. Stay on the auth boundary between cached device token state and shared gateway auth token flow. Do not restart a broad repo search.

patch.context_text: Use the triage handoff. Focus on the smallest safe remediation direction, focused validation, and rollback notes. Avoid broad remediation scans if the likely files are already known.

review.context_text: Assemble a reviewer-ready packet. Prefer prior artifacts and focused evidence over rediscovery.
